purpose: Research references for Masar Startup architecture and verification. Repositories are not funding opportunities and must never be inserted into the opportunities table.
reusePolicy: Prefer design patterns over copying source code.
Never copy code without a clearly applicable license.
Do not reuse UK/EU or India-specific eligibility rules as Palestinian rules.
Do not reuse ranking models without representative, human-labelled evaluation.
Preserve required third-party notices for code that is later copied.

projects.name: GrantMatch API
projects.licenseStatus: MIT identified in the repository; confirm at the exact commit before copying files.
reusablePatterns: Separate deterministic eligibility from semantic relevance and fit ranking.
Explain ranking factors instead of exposing an opaque score.
cautions: UK/EU data and eligibility rules do not transfer to Palestine.
README says the XGBoost reranker is disabled because synthetic data was insufficient; do not reuse its score as a validated model.
projects.recommendedUse: Design reference; implement Palestinian rules and calibrate only on labelled examples.

projects.name: Diligence
projects.licenseStatus: Repository declares MIT and includes a LICENSE file.
reusablePatterns: Trace every claim to a source and excerpt.
Distinguish supported, partial, missing, unverified and contradictory evidence.
Benchmark verification rather than trusting report fluency.
cautions: SEC EDGAR and FMP integrations are US-market focused and are not directly applicable to Palestinian grants.
projects.recommendedUse: Methodology for claim-evidence records and reviewer decisions.

projects.name: Pitch
projects.licenseStatus: README declares MIT terms; verify the license file and exact commit before copying substantial code.
reusablePatterns: Bounded pitch-review tasks and structured final reports.
Separate factual findings from improvement suggestions.
cautions: Do not add a Python service merely to imitate its stack; keep the analyzer aligned with Masar's architecture and deployment boundaries.

projects.name: Inovex
projects.licenseStatus: README points to ISC in the server package manifest; confirm license scope and notices before copying frontend/server files.
reusablePatterns: Incubation workflow, mentor/admin review, document status concepts.
cautions: Uses MongoDB; its collections are not a schema migration guide for PostgreSQL.
projects.recommendedUse: UI and workflow reference unless code license scope is checked.

projects.name: Student Opportunity Platform (SOP)
projects.licenseStatus: No root license was visible during this review; do not copy code unless permission is clarified.
reusablePatterns: Three-state eligibility outcomes and explanations as product concepts.
cautions: Small project activity and no clear license.

projects.name: Yojana-setu
projects.licenseStatus: No root license was visible during this review; do not copy source without permission.
reusablePatterns: Public-benefit scheme discovery, deterministic eligibility and relational storage concepts.
cautions: Jurisdiction-specific scheme data and scraping sources are not Palestinian funding opportunities.

fundingResearchUpdate: RISE Palestine has separate Startup Grant, TEAM Company Stipend, TEAM Freelancer Stipend, and SAFE Palestine bridge financing pathways; they are tracked as distinct opportunity candidates.
Official RISE pages are not fully consistent about application availability and the TEAM company amount period; all related candidates remain review-only.
